LPT request: How do I stop myself from eating chocolates?

I've been trying to lose weight. I've already lost around 23 kgs. (I was around 117 kgs, and now I weigh 95kgs. It's a work in progress. I'm 21 years old, M) But, I can't seem to stop myself from having a chocolate. I eat a bar or two every day. I just can't stop myself. They are addicting. I just find myself I do not drink, I do not smoke. But chocolates I can't seem to stop myself from. I understand that being healthy is a lifestyle, and not a goal. And I wanna cut down on chocolates. But, I don't know how. I'd love some advice. 0
